questions.question: Is this foil safe to use in the oven at high temperatures?
questions.answer: Yes, this Reynolds aluminum foil is oven-safe up to 500°F (260°C). It's designed for commercial kitchen use including baking, broiling, and wrapping. For best results, avoid direct contact with heating elements.

questions.question: What's the width of the foil in inches?
questions.answer: The foil is 12 inches wide and 1000 feet long. This is the standard commercial size that works well for covering full-size steam table pans, wrapping sandwiches, and general kitchen use.

questions.question: Can I use this on a charcoal grill?
questions.answer: Absolutely! This foil works great on charcoal grills. You can use it to wrap food for indirect cooking, create grill pouches with vegetables, or cover grill grates for easy cleanup. Just avoid placing it directly over open flames for extended periods.

questions.question: Are these cups safe for hot beverages?
questions.answer: Yes, Dart 4J4 foam cups are designed for both hot and cold beverages. The insulated foam keeps hot drinks warm while the exterior stays comfortable to hold. They're perfect for coffee, tea, hot cocoa, and more.

questions.question: What does 4oz mean — is that the capacity or the size?
questions.answer: 4oz refers to the fluid ounce capacity. These cups hold up to 4 fluid ounces (approximately 118ml). They're the standard size for espresso shots, sample portions, condiment cups, and small tasting servings.

questions.question: Can I recycle these foam cups?
questions.answer: Foam cups (#6 polystyrene) are recyclable in some areas, but not all municipalities accept them. Check with your local recycling program. Dart also offers foam recycling partnerships in certain regions. For commercial users, some waste management companies offer foam-specific recycling services.

questions.question: Do these cups need a sleeve for hot coffee?
questions.answer: Most customers find the Dart 8oz foam cups comfortable to hold without a sleeve, even with hot coffee. The foam insulation keeps the exterior cool enough. However, for extra-hot beverages or customers with sensitive hands, a sleeve is always an option.

questions.question: How many cups come in one case?
questions.answer: Each case contains 1,000 cups. They're packed in 20 sleeves of 50 cups each, making them easy to store and load into cup dispensers.

questions.question: Are these cups microwave-safe?
questions.answer: Yes, Dart foam cups are microwave-safe for reheating. They won't melt or release harmful chemicals in normal microwave use. However, they're not intended for extended high-power heating. For best results, heat in 30-second intervals.

questions.question: Are these bowls leak-proof for soups?
questions.answer: Yes, Dart 5oz foam bowls are designed to be leak-resistant. They work great for soups, stews, chilis, and other liquids. The foam construction prevents soak-through even with hot liquids.

questions.question: Can these go in the microwave?
questions.answer: Yes, these foam bowls are microwave-safe. You can reheat soups and other foods directly in the bowl. Use standard microwave power levels and avoid overheating.

questions.question: Are these containers really compostable at home?
questions.answer: Yes! These bagasse containers are 100% compostable. They'll break down in a commercial composting facility in 60-90 days. For home composting, it may take 3-6 months depending on your compost pile conditions. They're also microwave and freezer safe.

questions.question: Are these containers grease-resistant?
questions.answer: Yes, bagasse containers have natural grease resistance. They handle oily and greasy foods well without soaking through. However, for extremely greasy items, you may want to line them with parchment paper for extended holding times.

questions.question: Do lids come included or are they sold separately?
questions.answer: Lids are sold separately. You can find matching compostable bagasse lids in our store. The containers work great without lids for dine-in and immediate takeout, but we recommend lids for delivery orders.

questions.question: Are these containers dishwasher-safe?
questions.answer: Yes, these clear deli containers are top-rack dishwasher safe. They can also be hand-washed and reused multiple times. Many customers use them for meal prep and storage at home after purchasing food from delis.

questions.question: What's the actual diameter and height?
questions.answer: The 32oz deli containers have approximately a 7.5-inch diameter at the top and are about 4.5 inches tall. They're designed to stack efficiently in refrigerators and display cases.

questions.question: How much weight can these bags hold?
questions.answer: These #16 kraft paper bags can comfortably hold up to 15-20 pounds. The twisted paper handles are reinforced and designed for heavy loads. They're perfect for grocery orders, bakery items, and general retail packaging.

questions.question: Are these bags FDA-approved for food contact?
questions.answer: Yes, these kraft paper bags are made from food-grade materials and are FDA-approved for direct food contact. They're safe for packaging bakery items, deli foods, produce, and other food products.

questions.question: Are these gloves food-safe?
questions.answer: Yes, Ammex vinyl gloves are FDA-approved for food handling. They're powder-free, which prevents contamination, and are safe for direct contact with all food types including ready-to-eat foods.

questions.question: What size are these gloves?
questions.answer: These Ammex vinyl gloves come in a universal size that fits most adults. They have a loose-fit design for easy on/off and comfortable extended wear. The vinyl material provides good dexterity for food preparation tasks.

questions.question: Can people with latex allergies use these?
questions.answer: Absolutely! These are vinyl gloves, which are 100% latex-free. They're the recommended alternative for anyone with latex allergies or sensitivities. Vinyl is a safe, hypoallergenic material for food handling.

questions.question: What are the exact dimensions of these pans?
questions.answer: Half-size steam table pans measure approximately 10.44 inches long × 12.75 inches wide × 2.5 inches deep. They fit standard full-size and half-size steam table equipment. These are also called 'third pans' in some configurations.

questions.question: Can these go in the oven?
questions.answer: Yes, these aluminum steam table pans are oven-safe. They can handle temperatures up to 500°F (260°C). They're also freezer-safe, making them versatile for cooking, holding, serving, and storing food.

questions.question: Can I put boiling soup directly in these cups?
questions.answer: Yes, these poly-lined paper soup cups are designed to handle hot liquids including boiling soup. The poly lining prevents leaks and the paper wall provides insulation. They maintain their structural integrity with hot contents.

questions.question: Do these cups come with lids?
questions.answer: These soup cups are sold without lids. Compatible flat or dome lids are available separately in our store. For takeout and delivery, we recommend pairing them with matching lids to prevent spills.

questions.question: Are these cups BPA-free?
questions.answer: Yes, Solo portion cups are made from polypropylene (#5 plastic), which is BPA-free. They're safe for food contact and can handle both cold and warm (not boiling) contents.

questions.question: Can the lids handle being frozen?
questions.answer: Yes, both the cups and lids are freezer-safe. You can portion and freeze sauces, dressings, and other condiments. The snap-on lids stay secure in the freezer and the cups won't crack at low temperatures.

questions.question: Are these cups stackable for easy storage?
questions.answer: Yes, these portion cups and lids are designed to nest and stack efficiently. The cups stack tightly and the lids have a flat design for compact storage. They work great in standard portion cup dispensers.

questions.question: Are these plates really made from palm leaves?
questions.answer: Yes! These plates are made from fallen areca palm leaves. No trees are cut down — the leaves are collected after they naturally fall, then heat-pressed into plate shapes. They're 100% natural with no chemicals, dyes, or coatings.

questions.question: Can these handle hot and greasy food?
questions.answer: Yes, palm leaf plates are surprisingly sturdy. They can handle hot, greasy, and wet foods without bending or leaking. They're microwave-safe for reheating and can handle temperatures up to 220°F (104°C). Perfect for full meals.

questions.question: How long do they last before composting?
questions.answer: Unopened, these plates have a shelf life of 2+ years. Once in use, they're designed for single-use service but can be reused if hand-washed. In a commercial composting facility, they break down in 60-90 days. Home composting takes 3-6 months.
